target: ChemBase Pro (frontend + FastAPI backend + Supabase SQL + Vercel/Render config)

findings.title: Android Release Signing Keystore & Plaintext Passwords Tracked in Git
findings.remediation_notes: Untrack frontend/scripts/keys.json; owner must rotate Android upload key in Google Play Console and purge signing.keystore + signing-key-info.txt from git history via git filter-repo.

findings.title: Plaintext API Keys in Query Strings and Unscrubbed Error Responses
findings.remediation_notes: Switched Gemini calls in main.py and tutor_engine.py to x-goog-api-key header, scrubbed all upstream error messages in ai_proxy with scrub_secrets(), and added header support for Materials Project proxy.

findings.title: Hardcoded Fallback Encryption Master Key Active When ENVIRONMENT Unset on Render
findings.remediation_notes: Added ENVIRONMENT=production and CHEMBASE_MASTER_KEY (sync: false) to render.yaml so Render fails closed if master key is missing.

findings.title: Unauthenticated AI Proxy Abuse & Unlisted Model Bypass in /api/ai/chat
findings.remediation_notes: Enforced model_id allowlist against _effective_models_for_connection(conn), capped max_tokens (8192) and messages (50), and added optional REQUIRE_AI_AUTH=true JWT enforcement toggle.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Shared DB Writes via GET /api/search and POST /api/substances/bulk-resolve
findings.remediation_notes: Made GET /api/search strictly read-only on PubChem cache miss (no DB write on GET) and capped POST /api/substances/bulk-resolve batch size to 25 items.

findings.title: Supabase RLS Cross-Tenant Poisoning of Built-In Equipment Catalog (Missing is_custom=true Check)
findings.remediation_notes: Added USING (auth.uid() = user_id AND is_custom = true) WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id AND is_custom = true) to both SQL schema files; apply in Supabase SQL Editor.

findings.title: Client-Only Governance & System Toggles in localStorage
findings.remediation_notes: AI model governance is now enforced server-side via /api/admin/providers and /api/ai/chat; UI maintenance/module toggles remain local preview flags until migrated to Supabase.

findings.title: CSV Formula Injection in /api/export
findings.remediation_notes: Added _csv_safe() neutralization prefixing single quote on cells starting with =, +, -, @, tab, or CR.

findings.title: SSRF Fail-Open DNS, Materials Project Query Injection & Gemini Model Path Interpolation
findings.remediation_notes: Changed validate_safe_outbound_url to fail closed on DNS resolution failure; validated chemsys with ^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$ and model with ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,100}$.

findings.title: Prompt Injection via Unseparated User Inputs in AI Templates
findings.remediation_notes: No tool execution or code-eval sinks consume LLM output; JSON outputs are validated before rendering.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy & Missing Headers in frontend/vercel.json
findings.remediation_notes: Moved SW registration from inline script in index.html to main.tsx; added strict CSP and full security headers to both vercel.json and frontend/vercel.json.

findings.title: Proxy Rate-Limit IP Collapse & Unbounded In-Memory Caches
findings.remediation_notes: Extracted client IP via X-Forwarded-For first hop and added bounded eviction caps to _RATE_BUCKETS (2000), _TOKEN_CACHE (512), and ProblemFingerprinter._cache (256).

findings.title: Unbounded Request Batch Sizes & Export Memory Dump
findings.remediation_notes: Added batch caps (bulk_resolve <= 25, pubchem_enrich <= 20, messages <= 50, export limit <= 5000).

findings.title: Service Worker Caches All GET 200 Responses Including /api/* and no-store
findings.remediation_notes: Updated sw.js (chembase-pro-v3) to bypass Cache Storage for /api/*, cross-origin requests, Authorization headers, and Cache-Control: no-store/private responses.

findings.title: Hardcoded Personal Admin Email Exposed in Public Access-Denied UI Banner
findings.remediation_notes: Removed personal admin email string from the public Access Denied banner.
